Matching by web address and skipping existing bookmarks is right. Converting folders into tags should be on by default because it preserves the organization I already have.

Please default “Add imported bookmarks to To read” to off. A large browser import may contain years of already-seen links, and I don’t want hundreds of them flooding that view. I can turn it on when appropriate.

For export, title, tags, and original save date cover the standard format. Including my note, reading status, and archive status as compatible extra information is a good idea so an export re-imported into this app restores those details without preventing other bookmark apps from reading the file. With that default changed, import and export are settled.
